mapper.select:
SELECT COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME , COMPANY_NAME_ENG , BUSINESS_NO , OFFICER_NAME , MATERIAL_USE_YN , COMPANY_USE_YN FROM COMPANY WHERE 1 = 1
AND COMPANY_USE_YN = #{company_use_yn}
AND COMPANY_CODE ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
AND (COMPANY_NAME ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%') OR COMPANY_NAME_ENG ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%'))
AND BUSINESS_NO ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY COMPANY_CODE

SELECT COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME , COMPANY_NAME_ENG , COMPANY_NAME_LOC , BUSINESS_NO , OFFICER_NAME , OFFICER_NAME_ENG , OFFICER_PHONE_NO , OFFICER_EMAIL , COM_PHONE_NO , COM_FAX_NO , ZIP_CODE , ADDRESS , ADDRESS_ENG , CITY_NAME , CITY_NAME_ENG , COM_DE_MINIMIS_RATE , COM_RVC_RATE , INVENTORY_VALUATION_METHOD , CO_CERTIFIED_EXPORTER_YN , CERTIFICATION_NO , CERTIFICATION_TYPE , DEFAULT_LANGUAGE , HR_COMPANY_CODE , SEND_RECEIVE_IDENTIFIER_CODE , MATERIAL_USE_YN , COMPANY_USE_YN , BASIC_AGING_PERIOD , CTC_DECISION_ONLY_YN FROM COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMPANY ( COMPANY_CODE, COMPANY_NAME, COMPANY_NAME_ENG, COMPANY_NAME_LOC, BUSINESS_NO, OFFICER_NAME, OFFICER_NAME_ENG, OFFICER_PHONE_NO, OFFICER_EMAIL, COM_PHONE_NO, COM_FAX_NO, ZIP_CODE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_ENG, CITY_NAME, CITY_NAME_ENG, COM_DE_MINIMIS_RATE, COM_RVC_RATE, INVENTORY_VALUATION_METHOD, CO_CERTIFIED_EXPORTER_YN, CERTIFICATION_NO, DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, HR_COMPANY_CODE, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY, SEND_RECEIVE_IDENTIFIER_CODE, CERTIFICATION_TYPE, MATERIAL_USE_YN, COMPANY_USE_YN, BASIC_AGING_PERIOD, CTC_DECISION_ONLY_YN ) VALUES ( #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, #{company_name}, NULLIF(#{company_name_eng}, ''), NULLIF(#{company_name_loc}, ''), NULLIF(#{business_no}, ''), NULLIF(#{officer_name}, ''), NULLIF(#{officer_name_eng}, ''), NULLIF(#{officer_phone_no}, ''), NULLIF(#{officer_email}, ''), NULLIF(#{com_phone_no}, ''), NULLIF(#{com_fax_no}, ''), NULLIF(#{zip_code}, ''), NULLIF(#{address}, ''), NULLIF(#{address_eng}, ''), NULLIF(#{city_name}, ''), NULLIF(#{city_name_eng}, ''), CAST(#{com_de_minimis_rate} AS NUMERIC(5,2)), CAST(#{com_rvc_rate} AS NUMERIC(5,2)), NULLIF(#{inventory_valuation_method}, ''), #{co_certified_exporter_yn}, NULLIF(#{certification_no}, ''), NULLIF(#{default_language}, ''), NULLIF(#{hr_company_code}, ''), NOW(), #{update_by}, NOW(), #{update_by}, NULLIF(#{send_receive_identifier_code}, ''), NULLIF(#{certification_type}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{material_use_yn}, ''), 'N'), #{company_use_yn}, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(#{basic_aging_period}, ''), '0') AS NUMERIC), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ctc_decision_only_yn}, ''), 'N') )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMPANY SET COMPANY_NAME = #{company_name} , COMPANY_NAME_ENG = NULLIF(#{company_name_eng}, '') , COMPANY_NAME_LOC = NULLIF(#{company_name_loc}, '') , BUSINESS_NO = NULLIF(#{business_no}, '') , OFFICER_NAME = NULLIF(#{officer_name}, '') , OFFICER_NAME_ENG = NULLIF(#{officer_name_eng}, '') , OFFICER_PHONE_NO = NULLIF(#{officer_phone_no}, '') , OFFICER_EMAIL = NULLIF(#{officer_email}, '') , COM_PHONE_NO = NULLIF(#{com_phone_no}, '') , COM_FAX_NO = NULLIF(#{com_fax_no}, '') , ZIP_CODE = NULLIF(#{zip_code}, '') , ADDRESS = NULLIF(#{address}, '') , ADDRESS_ENG = NULLIF(#{address_eng}, '') , CITY_NAME = NULLIF(#{city_name}, '') , CITY_NAME_ENG = NULLIF(#{city_name_eng}, '') , COM_DE_MINIMIS_RATE = CAST(#{com_de_minimis_rate} AS NUMERIC(5,2)) , COM_RVC_RATE = CAST(#{com_rvc_rate} AS NUMERIC(5,2)) , INVENTORY_VALUATION_METHOD = NULLIF(#{inventory_valuation_method}, '') , CO_CERTIFIED_EXPORTER_YN = #{co_certified_exporter_yn} , CERTIFICATION_NO = NULLIF(#{certification_no}, '') , CERTIFICATION_TYPE = NULLIF(#{certification_type}, '') , DEFAULT_LANGUAGE = NULLIF(#{default_language}, '') , HR_COMPANY_CODE = NULLIF(#{hr_company_code}, '') , SEND_RECEIVE_IDENTIFIER_CODE = NULLIF(#{send_receive_identifier_code}, '') , MATERIAL_USE_YN = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{material_use_yn}, ''), 'N') , COMPANY_USE_YN = #{company_use_yn} , BASIC_AGING_PERIOD = CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(#{basic_aging_period}, ''), '0') AS NUMERIC) , CTC_DECISION_ONLY_YN = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ctc_decision_only_yn}, ''), 'N') , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() , UPDATE_BY = #{update_by} WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}

INSERT INTO COMPANY_OPTION SELECT OPTION_CODE, #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, OPTION_NAME, OPTION_DESC, OPTION_VALUE, NOW(), CREATE_BY, NOW(), UPDATE_BY FROM COMPANY_OPTION WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'ADMIN1000' AND OPTION_CODE IN ('BF', 'TR', 'SI', 'ME','MA')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_INFO SELECT USER_ID, #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, DIVISION_CODE, DEPT_NAME, PASSWORD, EMP_NO, NAME_KOR, NAME_ENG, NAME_LOCAL, POSITION_NAME, POSITION_NAME_ENG, EMAIL, CELL_PHONE_NO, OFFICE_PHONE_NO, FAX_NO, STATUS, USER_AUTH, DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, SSO_YN, NOW(), CREATE_BY, NOW(), UPDATE_BY, WORK_YYYY_MM FROM USER_INFO WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'ADMIN1000' AND USER_ID IN ('admin', 'fta', 'VENDOR')
INSERT INTO ROLE_MST SELECT ROLE_CODE, #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_DESC, NOW(), CREATE_BY, NOW(), UPDATE_BY FROM ROLE_MST WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'ADMIN1000'
INSERT INTO ROLE_USER SELECT 'ADMIN', 'fta', #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, NOW(), 'fta', NOW(), 'fta'

INSERT INTO ROLE_MENU SELECT 'ADMIN', RM.MENU_ID, #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, RM.CREATE_DATE, RM.CREATE_BY, RM.UPDATE_DATE, RM.UPDATE_BY, RM.REG_AUTH, RM.UPD_AUTH, RM.DEL_AUTH, RM.EXC_AUTH, RM.FLE_AUTH FROM ROLE_MENU RM INNER JOIN MENU ME ON ME.MENU_ID = RM.MENU_ID AND (NVL(ME.PARENT_MENU_ID,'0000') NOT IN ('G000','G001') OR NVL(ME.MENU_ID,'0000') = 'G011') WHERE RM.COMPANY_CODE = 'ADMIN1000' AND RM.ROLE_CODE='ADMIN' UNION ALL SELECT 'USER', RM.MENU_ID, #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, RM.CREATE_DATE, RM.CREATE_BY, RM.UPDATE_DATE, RM.UPDATE_BY, RM.REG_AUTH, RM.UPD_AUTH, RM.DEL_AUTH, RM.EXC_AUTH, RM.FLE_AUTH FROM ROLE_MENU RM INNER JOIN MENU ME ON ME.MENU_ID = RM.MENU_ID AND NVL(ME.PARENT_MENU_ID,'0000') NOT IN ('G000','G001') AND NVL(ME.MENU_ID,'0000') != 'G000' WHERE RM.COMPANY_CODE = 'ADMIN1000' AND RM.ROLE_CODE='USER'

INSERT INTO CODE_MST SELECT CATEGORY, #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, CATEGORY_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME_ENG, CATEGORY_NAME_LOC, CODE_LENGTH, UPDATE_YN, NOW(), CREATE_BY, NOW(), UPDATE_BY FROM CODE_MST WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'ADMIN1000'

INSERT INTO CODE_DTL SELECT CODE, CATEGORY, #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, CODE_NAME, CODE_NAME_ENG, CODE_NAME_LOC, SORT_NO, TXT_VALUE1, TXT_VALUE2, TXT_VALUE3, TXT_VALUE4, TXT_VALUE5, NUM_VALUE1, NUM_VALUE2, NUM_VALUE3, NUM_VALUE4, NUM_VALUE5, USING_YN, DELETE_YN, NOW(), CREATE_BY, NOW(), UPDATE_BY FROM CODE_DTL WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'ADMIN1000'

INSERT INTO INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL SELECT INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL_ID, IF_CODE, #{TMP_COMPANY_CODE}, COLUMN_TRANS_TYPE, TARGET_COLUMN, SOURCE_COLUMN, HISTORY_COLUMN, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_TYPE, COLUMN_LENGTH, COLUMN_DCMLPOINT_LENGTH, COLUMN_FORMAT_FORM, COLUMN_DFLT_VALUE, COLUMN_VRIFY_PROGRAM_NAME, COLUMN_REQUIRED_YN, PK_YN, USING_YN, ATTRIBUTE01, ATTRIBUTE02, ATTRIBUTE03, ATTRIBUTE04, ATTRIBUTE05, NOW(), CREATE_BY, NOW(), UPDATE_BY, SAMPLE_DATA FROM INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'ADMIN1000'
